description:
Hedgr connects your accounting data to treasury-grade FX risk analysis. Ask ChatGPT about your own book and get answers from your authenticated Hedgr workspace: current FX exposure by currency, entity and due date, cash balances, recorded hedges and hedge cover, policy limits, market regimes, rate-shock scenarios, cashflow timing and forecasts, overdue drivers and data-quality checks.

Try asking:
- What is my largest FX exposure right now?
- What would a 3% GBP move do to my open invoices?
- How much of my EUR exposure is already hedged?
- Are we inside our comfort limits?
- Which data source or connection is missing?

Works with Xero, QuickBooks Online, Sage, Google Sheets and CSV workspaces. Every tool is read-only. Hedgr does not execute trades, move money or give investment advice through this plugin; figures are indicative and decisions stay with you and your bank or FX broker.
